bullets.text: In Tiruvallur, angry residents took to the road at midnight due to a continuous power cut, and the office should monitor power supply restoration.
A sudden sinkhole near Nehru Nagar caused traffic disruption in Velachery, and the office should coordinate with transport authorities to clear the congestion.
The meteorological department issued an orange alert for Tiruvallur district due to Cyclone Murosu, and the office should coordinate disaster preparedness.
Velachery saw massive crowds for Diwali 2026 shopping, and the office should monitor safety and crowd management in the area.
Minister Puzhy Anand flagged off a drug awareness marathon in Besant Nagar organized by traders, and the office should support youth anti-drug initiatives.
The meteorological department issued an orange rain alert for Tiruvallur and Chennai for two days, and the office should monitor weather conditions.
Students and parents in Mambakkam Sathiram near Tiruttani fear venomous creatures due to an overgrown school campus, and the office should clear the bushes.
Damaged concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar ROB put Tiruvallur residents at risk, and the office should urge the State Highways department to repair it.
A human libraries discussion organized by Thamizhar Peravai analyzed how artificial intelligence permeates various levels of life, and the office should track digital trends.
Cisco President Jeetu Patel supports giving Gen Z unlimited AI to rethink software development, and the office should watch tech industry strategies.
